# Security Policy

## Reporting A Vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

Email [SECURITY CONTACT EMAIL] with:

- A clear description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce, proof of concept, or affected code paths.
- Any known impact on Reddit users, moderators, subreddits, Devvit Redis data, or Reddit moderation actions.
- Whether the issue is already public.

Please do not include real Reddit credentials, OAuth tokens, Devvit tokens, private subreddit data, or private moderator notes in the report.

## Response Expectations

Maintainers should acknowledge receipt within 7 days, triage the report, and coordinate a fix or disclosure plan when the issue is valid.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are handled on the default branch unless a maintainer documents release branches in the future.
